title: Damped Harmonic Oscillator Dark Energy and the Hubble Tension (Hussain, Arora, Wu, Zhu)
efc_relevance: Three-branch (under/critical/over-damped) DE EoS fit to Planck + DESI BAO + BBN + Cosmic Chronometers + (DES Y5 | Union3 | Pantheon+) gives H0 = 70.9 ± 1.1 (DES Y5) or 72.0 (+1.4/-2.1) (Union3), reducing the SH0ES tension to ~1.4σ at no Bayesian-evidence cost over ΛCDM. A direct H0-three-window competitor for EFC's P7 prediction; the damping coefficient is the functional analogue of EFC's K(ρ) saturation kernel.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as H0-three-window competitor anchor; cross-reference framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001, arXiv:2606.04886 (dissipative DE) and arXiv:2606.05539 (bulk-viscous DE); required mapping between damping coefficient and EFC K(ρ) in WP1; promote pending_review_2026_05_01 h0_three_window cluster.
